correctness.rationale: Headline audited is the submitted falsification: for theta graph (in particular Theta_(2,3,4)), H_2(Conf_n;Z) free for all n, so no Z/2 summand at n=5. Verified: (1) Swiatkowski model Def 2.7 (fetched ADCK20 html): S(Gamma;R)=R[E] tensor_v S(v), S(v)=Z<empty,v,h in H(v)>, |h|=(1,1), d(h)=e(h)-v(h). Degree = number of half-edge factors. (2) Thm 2.10 (fetched): H_*(B(Gamma);R) ~= H_*(S(Gamma;R)) naturally, R=Z included, differentials preserve weight. (3) Minimal-model step valid: Theta_(2,3,4) is homeomorphic to minimal Theta with 2 vertices A,B and 3 edges; unordered config spaces B_k depend only on underlying space, so homology equals that of minimal model. No subdivision functoriality beyond homeomorphism needed. (4) Degree bound: each S(v) contributes at most one half-edge generator; with 2 vertices every basis element has degree <=2, so C_3=0 in every weight, D3=0, H_2=ker(D2:C2->C1). C2 in fixed weight is free abelian (finite rank free on m*a_i*b_j), subgroup ker is free (PID). Hence no torsion, no z with 2z boundary but z non-boundary, uniformly in n. This falsifies target first clause and vacates persistence clause. (5) Computation is correctly labeled certificate, not needed for vanishing: independently replayed build (sympy) got identical dims/ranks k=4:41/96/54 r1=40 r2=53 H0=1 H1=3 H2=1; k=5:61/150/90 r1=60 r2=87 H0=1 H1=3 H2=3, entries in {-1,0,1}, D1*D2=0 exactly, H0=1 connectivity check, H2 ranks match ADCK Ex.3.5 field formula for Theta_3 (1 at k=4, 3 at k=5). Proof vs evidence distinguished as required.
